response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(L.IGA - L.IGM) AS avg_diff FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON L.ID = P.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS overall FROM p) SELECT p.SEX, AVG(p.avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(p.avg_diff) AS avg_iga_igm_diff, AVG(p.avg_diff / o.overall) AS avg_ratio FROM p CROSS JOIN o WHERE p.SEX <> '' GROUP BY p.SEX

assumptions.assumption: The overall mean of the IGA−IGM averages is taken over all patients with a lab match, including those with blank sex, because the request computes it before the sex breakdown and exclusion. Patients whose average is NULL are ignored by the mean.
Patients with NULL SEX are also excluded, since the filter SEX <> '' drops NULLs. Per-record IGA−IGM is only computed where both values are present.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall mean is computed only over patients with non-blank sex, so the exclusion applies before the overall mean.
